name: Lists all datasets in an account
description: Lists all datasets in an account Lists all threat event datasets configured in Cloudforce One. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/events/dataset
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/events/dataset
Lists all threat event datasets configured in Cloudforce One.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.
Optional: includeDeleted (query) — When true, include soft-deleted datasets in the response. Each item includes a `deletedAt` field (ISO 8601 or null). Default: false.

name: List indicators related to a tag within a dataset (deprecated)
description: List indicators related to a tag within a dataset (deprecated) This endpoint is deprecated. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/events/dataset/{dataset_id}/tags/{tag_uuid}/indicators
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/events/dataset/{dataset_id}/tags/{tag_uuid}/indicators
This endpoint is deprecated. Use GET /:account_id/events/tags/:tag_uuid/indicators with the optional datasetIds query parameter instead. Returns indicators associated with the provided tag UUID within a single dataset's indicator shards, with pagination.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; tag_uuid (path) — Tag UUID.; dataset_id (path) — Dataset UUID.
Optional: page (query); pageSize (query); indicatorType (query); relatedEvent (query) — Filter indicators by related event UUID(s). Multiple UUIDs can be provided by repeating the parameter.; search (query) — Structured search as a JSON array of {field, op, value} objects. Searchable fields: value, indicatorType. Multiple conditions are AND'd together. Max 10 conditions per request.
